title: Effectuation of Reconsiderations on Denied Referrals and Authorizations, Earlier Clauses
content:
This appeals effectuation memorandum for **Referrals and Authorizations** records the earlier clauses on approving a denied authorization after its reconsideration. Each of them is **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis and are kept only as the earlier text.

1. *(no longer in force)* A denied authorization is approved without a new review only when its reconsideration is decided overturned.
2. *(no longer in force)* The denial is approved on appeal only when a Medical Necessity Reconsideration or Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration case for this authorization is decided overturned. This was checked before the approval against the system record of the appeal case whose subject is the authorization.
3. *(no longer in force)* The approval takes the validity span and units the reconsideration decided, under the validity and units rule.

superseded_clauses: A denied authorization is approved without a new review only when its reconsideration is decided overturned.
The denial is approved on appeal only when a Medical Necessity Reconsideration or Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration case for this authorization is decided overturned.
The approval takes the validity span and units the reconsideration decided, under referral_validity_and_units.
